Nora (eng-ml): Quick follow-up from the eviction postmortem 11 We have 4 concrete eval action items to turn into PRs + infra tasks so we don't keep chasing this in incidents. Who can pick which?
Alex (eng-sre): I can take the chaos drill + runbook updates. Plan: run a safe staging drill that mimics partial KV loss + memory pressure. Target: Thu 14:00. Need a small driver script and abort hooks.
Jamie (eng-platform): I'll own infra + CI jobs. I'll add a nightly sweep job and a lightweight PR smoke job. Also will create an ephemeral cluster ticket STG-9123.
Ivy (eng-ml): I'll own the regression suite additions and the promptset. Proposed regression axes: seq=[64,256,1024,2048], batch=[1,8,32], kernel=[fp16,int8], cache_state=[cold,warm]. ETA: PR by next Wed.
Nora (eng-ml): Add a short promptset focused on long-reference chains and token-repeat patterns that historically triggered extra KV churn. Link it from the tracker and include a human-readable README.
Ivy (eng-ml): Example test command I'll include in PR: `pytest tests/eviction/test_regression.py::test_burst_then_read --env=staging --kernel=int8`
Alex (eng-sre): For the drill, I'll request a driver `tools/induce_kv_partial_loss --pct=30 --duration=120 --safe` and abort if error_rate > 0.8% sustained or infra quota is near. Will add triage signals: KV_miss_rate, cache_eviction_rate, p95_latency.
Jamie (eng-platform): CI plan: PR smoke = seq=64,batch=1,kernel=int8; nightly = full matrix. I'll add a dashboard tile `eviction-regression/nightly` and hook `runtime.kernel_fallback_count`.
Nora (eng-ml): Owners + due dates: Ivy=regressions+promptset (Wed), Alex=chaos+runbook (Thu), Jamie=infra+CI (Tue). I'll add these to the postmortem tracker and include pass criteria: 48h of nightly with no regression and p95 within 10% baseline.
Ivy (eng-ml): One risk to note: quantization rounding modes and QAT can change memory usage significantly. I'll add rounding and qat toggles to the matrix.
Alex (eng-sre): Also adding a small detection rule in runbook: if `runtime.kernel_fallback_count{kernel=\"int8\"} > 3` in 10m, escalate to SRE on-call.
AlertBot: Postmortem updated: https://redwood/pm/eviction-patterns 1 action_items: 3 assigned.
Jamie (eng-platform): Cluster provisioned STG-9123, CI job scaffolded `ci/nightly/eviction-matrix`. Posting ticket and job URL in tracker.
Nora (eng-ml): Please paste PR links and this thread ts into the tracker so we can follow status. We'll reconvene briefly in Monday standup to confirm merges and canary results.
Ivy (eng-ml): Uploaded draft PR with tests + promptset. Will request review from Nora + Alex.
Alex (eng-sre): Scheduled drill Thu 14:00 and will tag on-call live. Will post the driver artifact link in the PR when ready.
Nora (eng-ml): Thanks all. Close items after PRs merge and nightly runs pass for 48 hours. Mark items \"in progress\" in tracker.
